name: Onzoushi Mitsugi Mazoka Keikaku
original_name: 御曹司貢ぎマゾ化計画
source: A young man named Shuchi Izamori inherited a vast fortune. In his unfamiliar home, there was a young and enchanting stepmother, as well as a recently hired beautiful maid. Both aim to capture Izamori's wealth, intending to seduce the inexperienced young man and make him obedient by setting up lewd traps. Outside the house, additional threats are also targeting him.​
